Archive:377YE Spring Equinox Imperial ti.d: Each nation's senators and generals were recorded. Senator Hector of Zenith had been revoked by the Synod but was re-elected, so he cannot be revoked again until his seat next falls due. Gralka served as Conscience of the Senate and Septima of Shatterspire was appointed Warmage. New cardinals were appointed for Ambition, Courage, Pride and Vigilance. Six archmagi and six grandmasters, with their voting strengths, were named, and Simargl became Dean of the Lyceum. Imperial Bourse seats gained at Winter 376YE run until Winter 377YE. The Brilliant Shore, the Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund remain in Thule or Druj hands and will not be auctioned until those territories are reclaimed.

n.Dawn: Dawn's senators were Bohemond De Rondell (proxied), Ywain De Gauvain and Marek, and its generals were Floree de Rondell, Eryk Rykker and Frederick Novarion. Josephine became Cardinal of Pride and Agnetha de Rondell became Gatekeeper of Wisdom.
n.Druj: The Druj held the Great Forest at Reikos and the Great Pits of Ennerlund, which will not be auctioned as Bourse seats until Reikos and Holberg are Imperial again.
n.Highguard: Highguard held three senatorships and two generalships, under Matthias and Ruth. Lazarus became Cardinal of Courage, Asher and Silas became gatekeepers, Jessica was Grandmaster of the Sevenfold Path and Obadiah held the Vigilant Swan.
n.Imperial Orcs: The orc Gralka remained Conscience of the Senate. Klor and Braka led the Winter Sun and Summer Storm, and Bruk held the Steel Fist.
n.Navarr: Navarr's senators were Cei Windstrider, Bledri Eternal and Caerwyn Summer Crow, and Cerunnos and Kale Vigil were its generals. Tockryn Nighthaven remained Cardinal of Wisdom, Meir Pathfinder led the Rod and Shield and Idris Eternal held the Thimble.
n.The Brass Coast: The Freeborn senators were Sallur, Rauul and Avisena, and Yasmina and Deigo were the generals. Darius remained Gatekeeper of Prosperity and Tabib held the Broken Shore Bounty.
n.The League: The League held three senatorships, Stanislav Krieger's Wolves of War and four cardinalships, with Olek newly made Cardinal of Ambition. Leaguers also held many Imperial Bourse seats, the Regario Dossier and the post of Master of the Imperial Mint.
n.The Marches: The Marches' senators were Richard of Bourholt, Bridget Talbot and Henry Ward, and Bjorn, Edwin de Warrene and William Tanner were its generals. Alan Young's status as Gatekeeper of Loyalty was unresolved, and William Bolholt was Grandmaster of the Golden Pyramid.
n.Thule: The Thule held the Brilliant Shore, which will not be auctioned until Skarsind is an Imperial territory again.
n.Urizen: Urizen's senators were Ioseph, Probus and Hector, who was re-elected after the Synod revoked him. Decius Cascade led the Citadel Guard and Valerian of Phoenix Reach held the Legacy.
n.Varushka: Varushka's senators were Constantin, Yelislaveta and Maxim, and Zakhar the grim and Stanislav Borodin Havel were its generals. Petra became Cardinal of Vigilance, Alexei led the Unfettered Mind and Simargl became Dean of the Lyceum.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark's senators were Hengest Dun, Uskolli and Atte, and Merrick and Erkenbrand were its generals. Wyrda Bjornadottir was Grandmaster of the Shuttered Lantern and Joakim held the Stonefield Ice Caves.

t.Bregasland: Richard of Bourholt was senator for Bregasland, the Dour Fens.
t.Casinea: Cyrus of Felix's Watch was senator for Casinea.

t.Hahnmark: Hengest Dun was senator for Hahnmark.
t.Hercynia: Cei Windstrider was senator for Hercynia.
t.Holberg: Holberg had no senator listed, and its Great Pits of Ennerlund were held by the Druj, not to be auctioned until Holberg is Imperial again.
t.Kahraman: Rauul i Jannat i Riqueza was senator for Kahraman.
t.Madruga: Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra was senator for Madruga.
t.Miaren: Bledri Eternal was senator for Miaren.
t.Miekarova: Yelislaveta Syrnova Vlanich was senator for Miekarova.
t.Mitwold: Bridget Talbot was senator for Mitwold, Pride of the Marches.
t.Necropolis: Adamah of the Silent Tide was senator for Necropolis.

t.Semmerholm: Ywain De Gauvain was senator for Semmerholm.

r.Holberg/Ennerlund: The Great Pits of Ennerlund were held by the Druj and will not be auctioned as a Bourse seat until Holberg is once again an Imperial territory.

Fortify multiple towns.d: Proposed by Upwold and seconded by Sermersuaq, the motion passed at a cost of 60 Thrones with 9 votes against, and the money went to Upwold. White granite was put towards fortifying regions in Miaren, Karov and Semmerholm. The motion broke constitutional protocol because Senate motions should contain a single item, but magistrates did not strike it down and construction began. The civil service suggested an Imperial position with authority and a treasury stipend to order fortifications would have achieved the same end. Seren, Delev and Lacre were only partially fortified. This curbs banditry but gives no military advantage, and 261 more wains of white granite are needed to complete all three.

n.Dawn: A Dawnish territory, Semmerholm, was one of the three chosen for fortification, though the work there remained only partial.
n.Navarr: The Navarr territory of Miaren was chosen as one of the three sites, but its fortification was left incomplete.
n.The Marches: The Marcher senator for Upwold proposed the motion, received the funds and chose which towns would be fortified.
n.Varushka: Karov, a Varushkan territory, was selected for fortification and received partial defences that ease banditry but give no military edge.

t.Karov: White granite was spent fortifying a region in Karov, but the fortification stayed partial: enough to deal with banditry, not enough to count as a full fortification.
t.Miaren: A region in Miaren was partially fortified under the motion, which helps against banditry but needs more white granite to become a proper fortification.
t.Semmerholm: Fortification work began in a region of Semmerholm but was left incomplete, giving relief from banditry but no military advantage.
t.Upwold: Upwold's senator proposed the motion, received the Senate's funds and selected the three sites, none of which lay in Upwold itself.

Fund the Academy.d: Proposed by the senator for Bastion and seconded by the senator for Casinea, the motion asked the Senate to fund the Academy so that it could provide resources for training the next generation. It passed at a cost of 5 Thrones, with 12 votes recorded against. The motion is complete, and the funds were disbursed to Simiel of the Shattered Tower, the Senator for Bastion.

n.Highguard: A Highborn senator, Simiel of the Shattered Tower, proposed the funding and received the 5 Thrones on Bastion's behalf to resource the Academy.

t.Bastion: Bastion's senator proposed the motion, and the 5 Thrones granted for the Academy were paid out to Bastion through Simiel of the Shattered Tower.

Repair Holberg defences.d: Proposed by the senator for Necropolis and seconded by Karov, the motion followed plans that the engineer Rhiner Van Hesselman had presented to the League. It passed with 45 Thrones in favour and 13 votes against, and the funds were disbursed to Adamah of the Silent Tide, Senator for Necropolis. The cost was 100 crowns, 25 wains of white granite, 10 wains of weirwood, 25 measures of Bladeroot and 25 measures of Imperial Roseweald. Oksana Kazaku, senator for Temeschwar, paid it during the Spring Equinox downtime. Van Hesselman's plans were carried out and Holberg's defences were repaired to their pre-siege levels.

n.Druj: The walls and gates of Holberg, a territory then outside Imperial control and held by the Druj, were rebuilt to their pre-siege strength by Imperial effort.
n.Highguard: Highguard's senator for Necropolis, Adamah of the Silent Tide, proposed the repairs and received the funds to carry them out.
n.The League: Plans by the League engineer Rhiner Van Hesselman were used to restore the defences of Holberg, and the Temeschwar senator paid for the work.

t.Holberg: Holberg's gates and walls were repaired to full, pre-siege strength, although the territory was not under Imperial control at the time.
t.Necropolis: Mentioned in passing: the senator for Necropolis proposed the motion and received the funds for the repairs.
t.Temeschwar: Mentioned in passing: Oksana Kazaku, senator for Temeschwar, paid for the repairs during the Spring Equinox downtime.

Repair the Spider's Dream.d: Proposed by the senator for Madruga and seconded by Feroz, the motion sought funds to repair the Spider's Dream bridge, which had fallen into a sorry state. It passed at a cost of 15 Thrones, with 3 votes against, and the money went to Madruga. The project required 20 wains of weirwood, all provided by Avisena i Ezmara i Guerra, Senator for Madruga, and the repairs were completed. Restoring the bridge reinstated the Spider's Tollkeep sinecure, which had lapsed under Emperor Walter. It pays its holder 2 Thrones each season from tolls. The holder is chosen unanimously by the senators of the Brass Coast and the League, and the post was left vacant.

n.The Brass Coast: A Brass Coast senator proposed the motion and personally supplied the weirwood. Brass Coast senators now share, with the League's, the unanimous choice of who holds the restored Spider's Tollkeep sinecure.
n.The League: League senators gain a joint say, with the Brass Coast, in appointing the holder of the reinstated Spider's Tollkeep sinecure, which is funded by tolls on the bridge into Sarvos.

t.Madruga: Madruga's senator proposed the repair and provided the 20 wains of weirwood, and the Senate's funds were distributed to Madruga to restore its end of the bridge.
t.Sarvos: The Spider's Dream, Sarvos's bridge link to Madruga, was repaired and restored to working order, allowing tolls to be collected for the Spider's Tollkeep once more.

Support medical school and Anvil hospita.d: The motion called for funds to be disbursed for the benefit of a medical school and an Anvil hospital, and for both to be formally recognised as Imperial institutions. The Senate solicited testimony from an expert witness, Elizabeth Eastville née Talbot. The motion passed at 20 Thrones with 11 votes against, and no further cost is recorded. The funds were disbursed to Richard of Bourholt, Senator for Bregasland, who proposed the motion. It was seconded by Sarvos.

n.The Marches: A Marcher senator, Richard of Bourholt of Bregasland, led the motion and was entrusted with the funds for the new medical school and Anvil hospital.

t.Bregasland: Bregasland's Senator, Richard of Bourholt, proposed the motion and received the disbursed funds to put towards the medical school and the hospital in Anvil.
